example: The alleged suspect ran away last night and now everybody thinks he must be guilty.
example_zh: 那個可疑的嫌犯在昨晚逃跑了，現在每個人都認為他一定有罪。
chinese: 聲稱的；被斷言的；可疑的
memory_hint: alleged 由 allege 加 -d 而成，表示聲稱的、被指稱的。

example: I like roses but unfortunately I'm allergic to them.
example_zh: 我喜歡玫瑰花，但不幸的是我對玫瑰花過敏。
memory_hint: allergic to 表對…過敏，也可比喻非常厭惡。

example: I'm sneezing but I don't have a cold; it's just an allergy.
example_zh: 我在打噴嚏，但我沒有感冒，那只是過敏。

example: Research shows that singing can alleviate stress.
example_zh: 研究顯示唱歌能減輕壓力。
memory_hint: alleviate 表減輕痛苦、壓力或問題。

example: You won't find any alligators here; they usually live in hot and wet areas.
example_zh: 你在這兒看不到短吻鱷，牠們通常生活在濕熱地帶。

example: Television news is an alloy of journalism and show business.
example_zh: 電視新聞是新聞和表演的結合體。
memory_hint: alloy 可指金屬合金，也可比喻混合物。

example: The young girl who has a pair of almond eyes is very charming.
example_zh: 那個有一雙杏眼的年輕女孩很有魅力。
memory_hint: almond 指杏仁，也可形容杏仁狀。

example: You can go shopping with us
example_zh: or alternatively
chinese: you can wait for us at home.
synonyms: 和我們去購物還是在家等我們，你可以二者擇一。
page_end: alternatively 表或者、作為另一選擇。

example: The company didn't make amends to him for his loss so he sued the company.
example_zh: 公司沒有賠償他的損失，所以他就控告公司。

example: They were well equipped with weapons and ammunition and were ready to set off.
example_zh: 他們已經裝備好了武器和彈藥，隨時待命出發。

example: The public demonstrated
example_zh: demanding a blanket amnesty for the strikers.
chinese: 民眾示威遊行，要求對罷工者全部赦免。

example: I have ample reason to believe he is innocent.
example_zh: 我有充足的理由相信他是無辜的。

example: Drawing analogies is one way of giving examples.
example_zh: 畫出相似的東西是舉例的一種方式。

example: If you are puzzled
example_zh: you can consult Tom. He has an analytical mind.
chinese: 如果你有疑問可以請教 Tom，他有善於分析的頭腦。
page: analytical 指善於分析或分析性的。

example: You cannot anchor all your hopes in your father's help; instead
example_zh: you should depend on yourself.
chinese: 你不能把全部的希望都繫在你父親身上，相反地，你應該靠自己。
page: anchor 可作動詞表示固定、使停泊。

example: Anecdotes about the princess are so interesting that you must ask him to tell you about them some day.
example_zh: 關於公主的軼事非常有趣，你改天一定要他說給你聽。
memory_hint: anecdote 指短小有趣的軼事。

example: The author chooses to remain anonymous because she wants to live a simple life.
example_zh: 作者選擇保持匿名，因為她想過簡單的生活。

example: Ask your father to adjust the antenna; the reception is not so good.
example_zh: 叫你父親調整一下天線，因為接收效果不怎麼好。
memory_hint: antenna 指天線或昆蟲觸角。

example: Most people get excited whenever they hear the playing of their national anthem.
example_zh: 大多數人一聽到國歌的演奏，都很激動。
memory_hint: anthem 常指國歌或讚美詩。

example: This factory makes antibiotics
example_zh: which are substances that kill germs.
chinese: 這個工廠生產抗生素，抗生素是一種殺菌物質。

example: The doctor told him our bodies can produce antibodies which protect us from disease.
example_zh: 醫生告訴他我們的身體可產生抗體，抗體可以保護我們免受疾病侵襲。
memory_hint: antibody 指免疫系統產生的抗體。

example: "Tall" is the antonym of "short".
example_zh: 「高」是「矮」的反義字。

example: Racial discrimination was institutionalized after the apartheid laws were enacted in 1948 in South Africa.
example_zh: 南非於1948年頒佈種族隔離法，從此種族歧視被制度化。
memory_hint: apartheid 指歷史上的種族隔離制度。

example: Of course they had special breathing apparatus
example_zh: otherwise
chinese: they wouldn't have been able to survive in space.
synonyms: 他們當然有特殊的呼吸裝置，要不然在太空中就不能存活。
page_end: apparatus 指設備、裝置；通常作集合或不可數概念使用。

example: Check the appendices of the dictionary. Maybe you will find what you want.
example_zh: 查看一下字典的附錄，也許會找到你想要的東西。
